page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5.2xlarge belongs to the Local SSDs instance family, engineered for workloads requiring dedicated processing resources paired with local high-speed disk capacity. Operating under KVM hypervisor management on the x86_64 instruction set architecture, the instance includes an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz across 8 dedicated vCPUs. Hardware accelerators such as discrete GPUs are not present in this configuration.

System memory totals 64.0 GB, maintaining an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Storage is provided via a bundled 1919 GB local SSD directly attached to the host node, delivering low-latency I/O without relying solely on network-attached block volumes. Network communication is backed by a 20 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, though complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included in the standard allocation.

The 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio combined with nearly two terabytes of direct-attached solid-state storage makes this configuration suitable for database management systems, in-memory caching layers, search indexing, and transactional logging. Because storage is local to the underlying physical server, architectural implementations must account for host-level redundancy and snapshotting strategies to maintain data durability.

The instance integrates 1919 GB of local SSD storage directly onto the host, minimizing latency for disk I/O operations. The balance of 8 GB of memory per core alongside direct-attached high-capacity local storage supports relational databases, NoSQL stores, search engines, and real-time analytical processing without requiring discrete graphics hardware.
